notes.title: Update 20171104
notes.notes:
This update includes:

•	A new level 3 (that makes 5 levels ready to be played)
•	A new pause function. Just press the menu button to toggle pause
•	An extensive audio update (it’s still experimental ;-)
•	Some bug fixes
•	Death (New!)
•	Improved spawning patterns
